description: An ordered stack of dated Sentinel-2 stills of one site from t0 to t1, one per window (max_frames, default 6), each with its own scene date. A window with no clear scene is an explicit empty frame, not charged. Agent keys only. Metered: see CHARGING in the server instructions; quote first with `billing_quote`.

entity_type.description: Entity kind: deposit | infrastructure | company | project.

id.description: Entity id to anchor on (with entity_type).

max_cloud.description: Maximum cloud cover of a scene, 0-100 percent. Default 20.

max_frames.description: How many equal windows to cut the range into, 1-12; one still per window. Default 6.

t0.description: Start of the date range, YYYY-MM-DD, on or after 2015-06-23. Required.

t1.description: End of the date range, YYYY-MM-DD. Default today.

name: look_through
